name: multi_element_demo
_comment: Multi-body demo: the slat and flap of the JAXA 30P30N high-lift wing,
The point of this example is the v2 'cads' LIST — one entry per geometry.
Before v2 a script could name only ONE CAD geometry, so a multi-body case
could not be described (or re-run) from a script at all; saving a script
from a multi-tab workspace silently dropped everything but the active tab.
Every entry sets skip:true, i.e. feed the geometry straight to the mesher
without resampling. Drop 'skip' and add a 'segments' array to have
surface_resampler redistribute that element's surface points first; each
entry resamples independently and all outputs become mesh boundaries.
makes the full three-element configuration, but the BL then has to be sized
for the slat gap (~1% chord) and the main element's flap cove — with the
settings below the offset fronts collide there. That is BL-vs-geometry
sizing, not a limitation of the multi-geometry pipeline.
